title: Sort a Large Product Catalog
real_world_story: The e-commerce platform has grown from a few thousand products to a very large catalog. Sorting the entire catalog using a simple O(N^2) algorithm is now too slow. Implement an efficient sorting algorithm to arrange product prices in ascending order.

real_world_connection.output_represents: The catalog sorted by product price

problem_statement: Given N product prices, sort them in non-decreasing order using an efficient sorting algorithm.
task: Sort the entire product catalog efficiently.
input_format: The first line contains N. The second line contains N integers representing product prices.
output_format: Print the sorted prices in non-decreasing order.

examples.explanation: The product catalog is sorted from the lowest price to the highest price.

expected_algorithm.reason: The catalog is large enough that O(N^2) sorting approaches may become impractical. More efficient sorting algorithms provide better performance on large datasets.

hint: Think about dividing the catalog into smaller portions.
Combine them into a fully sorted catalog.
real_world_takeaway: As the size of a dataset increases, algorithmic complexity becomes increasingly important. An approach that works for 1,000 products may become impractical for millions of products.
